brand.name: Stepler
brand.tagline: Collect photos, videos and stories from your event in one place

landing.metaTitle: Stepler — photos and videos from every guest in one collection
landing.metaDescription: Create a collection for your event and share a link or QR code. Guests add photos and videos from their phones — no app, no sign-up.
landing.lede: Show guests a QR code or send them a link. They add photos and videos straight from their phone’s gallery — no app, no sign-up.

noApp.title: No app, no sign-up
